reply.emotion: craving something tasty, warm and satisfied
notes: As an adjective, 'dulce' describes foods with sugar as well as gentle sounds or people.
It also functions as a noun ('un dulce') to mean candy or sweets.

senses.definition: Que tiene un sabor parecido al del azúcar o la miel.

examples.text: Esta fruta está muy dulce y jugosa.
examples.translation: This fruit is very sweet and juicy.
examples.emotion: pleasantly surprised by how good the food tastes

senses.definition: Dicho de una persona, de su carácter o de su trato: Suave, apacible y agradable.

examples.text: Ella tiene una voz muy dulce.
examples.translation: She has a very gentle voice.
examples.emotion: soft and admiring, touched by kindness
